user.title: Connect to WattPost Cloud
user.description: Paste an API token from [WattPost → Account → API keys]({docs}). Self-hosters can override the base URL.

pick_site.title: Pick a site
pick_site.description: Choose which paired appliance this Home Assistant device represents. To monitor more than one site, re-run the integration setup once per site.

error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Mint a fresh one at WattPost → Account → API keys.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach WattPost Cloud. Check the base URL and your network.
error.no_sites: Your account has no paired appliances yet. Pair one in the WattPost dashboard first.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
